body: @abelsromero any chance you could create a quick reproducer? It would be helpful. Thanks!

Sure! Here it is a stripped version of my project https://github.com/abelsromero/quarkus-issue3949.
The readme contains instructions about how to run it.

The issue is that RollbackException is a checked exception, so Arc needs to wrap it in a RuntimeException. If you add 'throws javax.transaction.RollbackException' to save() (and all callers of save) this will work as expected.

That said we could probably make this work better, maybe Arc could have a specific RuntimeException subclass it throws in this case, and Resteasy could know to unwrap it. CC @mkouba @patriot1burke

It's been a while since I worked with JAX-RS and my memory could be wrong. But  I thought the system checked exceptions in the stacktrace looking for a match.
But the fix makes me think that only top of the stack exception is are being macthed.
Answering myself, I recreated the project in Thorntail, and the mappers only capture the top of the stack exception. In that case, the fix should sufice.
